label: preparing
what: A secret surprise service jubilee for the mayor, scheduled for day 1 at 18:00: prepare a great hall with eight lanterns and two hundred fresh loaves, and discreetly bring the mayor there. Innkeeper, freight, builder, and baker participated; the innkeeper and freight arranged supplies and lanterns, builder installed lanterns/handled mayor's escort and bartered for 80 loaves, and baker supplied those 80 loaves. The mayor was not told the true purpose beforehand; the neighbor was also deliberately kept uninformed, but is not shown knowingly helping. The secretary recorded the cover-story appointment, but no evidence shows they knowingly assisted the surprise.
